6816.title: macOS desktop responsiveness: attribution not established
6816.rootCauseOneLine: Undetermined: no affected macOS renderer trace or repeatable workload attributes the intermittent stutter.
6816.proposedFix: Capture an in-session renderer Performance trace via View > Toggle Developer Tools; separate streaming and completed intervals before selecting a fix.
6816.caveats: No macOS/Apple Silicon desktop or memory-pressure workload available. Existing desktop controls passed 46 tests in each of two clean checkouts; this does not reproduce stutter. Full build blocked by unrelated SDK runtime prerequisites. Commands and outputs are inline per reports publication policy.
